chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Abu Sa'id, from Abdul Malik ibn Amr, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'I buy one hundred rawiyas of oil, so I display one rawiya and two, then I weigh both of them, then I take the rest of it based on that measurement.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'There is no problem.'

key_terms.رَاوِيَة: A unit of measurement for oil (approx. 10-12 kg)
key_terms.سَائِرَهُ: The remainder / the rest of it
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: There is no problem / It is permissible

ai.seo_question: How is the price of bulk oil determined when buying by sample in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi validates the commercial practice of 'estimation based on sample' (al-kala' bil-kala'), where the quality of a small weighed sample determines the price of the entire bulk purchase. It highlights the Imams' pragmatic approach to trade, ensuring fairness and preventing deception in transactions involving non-uniform or hard-to-inspect goods. This ruling provides a practical legal framework for bulk trading that remains relevant in modern commodity markets.
